introHtml: Oxford-style golf polo shirts combine the classic button-down collar of a dress shirt with the breathable performance fabric of a polo. This hybrid style is ideal for corporate golf tournaments, company retreats, or any event where you want your team to look sharp on and off the course. The structured collar holds its shape well, making it suitable for embroidery on the chest or sleeve, and the wrinkle-resistant material keeps everyone looking neat from the first tee to the 19th hole.
